meta.title: oh-my-workflow — the open dynamic-workflow runtime
meta.desc: The portable twin of Claude Code's native dynamic Workflow. Plain-JS orchestration whose nodes are whole coding-agent CLIs.

landing.pill: the open twin of Claude Code's dynamic Workflow
landing.tagline: Write a plain-JS orchestration script. Its nodes are whole coding-agent CLIs you already have — claude -p, codex exec, hermes. omw is the thin, readable glue.
landing.ctaPrimary: Try it free — no API key
landing.twinHeading: Same shape as the native tool. Anywhere.
landing.twinSub: The script is nearly identical — what differs is what a node is and where it runs.
landing.twinNativeLabel: native dynamic Workflow — inside Claude Code
landing.honestTitle: This is slower and pricier than a raw-API orchestrator — on purpose.
landing.honestBody: A node is a whole coding agent, not one completion: it reads your repo, runs tools, iterates. You pay process + agent-loop overhead per node. The payoff: you orchestrate agents, not models — and Claude Code itself ships this exact pattern internally. omw is the portable twin, with the trade-offs named, not hidden.

adapters.name: claude
adapters.notes: JSON output + --resume powers in-session schema self-repair

docs.title: Introduction
docs.intro: oh-my-workflow (omw) is the open, portable twin of Claude Code's native dynamic Workflow. You write a plain-JS orchestration script whose nodes are whole coding-agent CLIs; omw runs the script, schema-gates each node's output, and journals every step.
docs.quickstartBody: No API key, no network — the built-in fake adapter runs the whole spine:
docs.hookAgentBody: Run one coding-agent CLI node. With a schema, omw validates and re-prompts the node with the errors up to 2×. Never throws (the null-contract) — except budget exhaustion.
docs.hookFlowBody: Per-item flow vs. barrier. Default to pipeline.
docs.adaptersBody: A node is a coding agent driven through its headless prompt→result CLI: fake, claude, codex, hermes, pi (planned). A missing CLI exits 3 with an install hint.
